posts.author: Soul
posts.body: Many of my friends are having difficulty when reading text in my game. They keep accidentally causing messages to skip over to the next by holding "Shift", or double-tapping when the message is just about done appearing. I would like to request a script that will at least disable the "Shift" key, at most that and keep the "Confirm" and "Cancel" inputs from speeding up the message until all text has displayed. If it could be given a switch to turn this on/off with, that would be appreciated as well.

posts.author: Aoi Ninami
posts.body: Please consider how annoying it would be to have no ability to skip text on a second playthrough, or if you lose progress for whatever reason and have to redo a portion of the game.

Hi! I know I’m really late to the party, but maybe someone out there is still looking for a solution to this problem, like I was. So here you go! (I did this in RPG Maker MV, so I’m not sure if it works the same way in other versions.)
Go to your
js
folder in your project
Open
rpg_windows.js
(make a backup copy somewhere safe in case something goes wrong!)
Find the line that says
Window_Message.prototype.updateShowFast = function() {
Change
this._showFast = true;
to
this._showFast = false;
And that’s it! You can also use something like
YEP_MessageCore
and enable
fast forward
option if you want the player to have any skip message option. Hope this helps anyone
​

Ruby:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Update Fast Forward Flag
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_show_fast
    @show_fast = true if Input.trigger?(:C)
  end
